peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 8.5% below its local comparables; 45 of 130 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (54.7): 3.2 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 212 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 6). Context, not scored: resales in 79.2% of months (24 months).

rentalYield.caption: Gross yield = 12 x typical rent / typical resale price for the same size band. Before maintenance, property tax, vacancy and agent fees. Not a return on your cash. Lease: Freehold.

rules.peers: same class, market segment and 100 sq ft size band; original lease 99 years or longer, including freehold and 999-year (short leases excluded)
rules.range: the range from combining the middle half of rents with the middle half of prices (12 x lower-quartile rent / upper-quartile price to 12 x upper-quartile rent / lower-quartile price); not a confidence interval
rules.shortLease: Developments with leases under 99 years are excluded from standard long-lease peer groups.

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $2,195,000 ($2,291 psf, 957 sq ft; 8 resales, Jun 2024–May 2026); 6 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,411 psf (range $1,506–2,829); 5% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $115,000 less. 3-bedroom: median $3,150,000 ($2,393 psf, 1,259–1,453 sq ft; 8 resales, Sep 2025–Aug 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,719 psf (range $2,080–3,038); 12% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $429,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Tanjong Katong MRT about 240 m, Marine Parade MRT about 620 m; closer than 544 of 662 similar developments (the same as 8). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest Tanjong Katong Primary School about 390 m; more than 126 of 662 similar developments (the same as 165). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 8 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 350 m), more than 281 of 662 similar developments (the same as 80); nearest hawker centre Marine Parade Central Market And Food Centre about 810 m; nearest park Marine Parade Rd Park about 500 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Marine Parade Central Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Amber House, 31 new sales, about 170 m; Emerald of Katong, 2 new sales, about 330 m; Tembusu Grand, 11 new sales, about 480 m; Ardor Residence, 13 new sales, about 490 m; The Continuum, 208 new sales, about 1,020 m; Meyer Blue, 20 new sales, about 1,040 m; Grand Dunman, 72 new sales, about 1,130 m; Koon Seng House, 6 new sales, about 1,290 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 412 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 474 new sales and 850 resales (1,324 purchases); new sales were 35.8% of these purchases. Subsales (42) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 850 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 396 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 850 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,018 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−16.5%). Planning-area private resales −4.5%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
